findings.detail: B01 denominator appears to include a separate comparative-period SOI block even though the 2024 current-period SOI has fair values and ties to Total Investments of 256,654,766.
Issuer/group rows in the SOI are labels without fair value, while adjacent investment leaf rows carry fair value, so label rows should not be counted as fair-value-bearing leaves.

citation.quoted_text: 2X LLC issuer label row has no cost or fair value cells; adjacent Term Loan row carries fair value.

rationale: Class 3 aggregate review. The filing source provides a current-period SOI total fair value of 256,654,766 at table 15 row 22, and representative current investment rows have populated fair value cells. The source also contains a separate comparative SOI block ending with 208,574,078 at table 37 row 11. The observed B01 metric, 325/657 = 0.4947, is therefore grounded as a row-scope/comparative-period leak rather than an absence of fair values in the source.

culprit_citations.quoted_text: 2X LLC Term Loan current-period investment row carries fair value $1,776,963
